Important Notice: my Patreon got nuked yesterday and I have no way to contact my patrons, so this is more or less the only way I can inform people as to what happened. as for the specific terms that has been violated: both Succubus Sister and Fatal were reported by someone for having incest, which is not the case. both Akira and Rei are suppose to be from two separate families, my assumption was someone got the wrong idea because the term 'onii-chan' is used when referring to Rei by Akira. and I don't even know why Fatal was reported in the first place.

as such I have filed for an appeal, but assuming it works, there is a good chance that I will change the story to make sure people don't get the wrong idea, or remove the comic from my patreon all together.

assuming it fails, I was informed that patrons subscribed during February will be refunded, it's an unfortunate turn of events and I'm terribly sorry for what has happened. I'm not really sure where I will go from here, but I will inform if something change in the future.

What to expect: This is mainly a gender-bender (gender morph) story, with the main character being aware of the transformation happening in his body.

I've also noticed another user had made a French translation of the comic, you can check it out here:
